As-built file (DOE) register

For project managers, construction coordinators, general contractors and engineering firms at project close-out. The documents of the as-built file, work package by work package: each package added gets its standard list (as-built drawings, operating and maintenance manuals, test reports, product data sheets, warranties) from a built-in base of 20 building work packages, editable; optional item for the later-works safety file (DIUO). Four statuses (expected, received, to be reworked, approved), dated reminders with a ready-to-copy letter, completeness per package and per contractor, printable transmittal slip and missing-documents list, CSV export.
